party.note: Two parties travelling together: Ni Ni's group of 2 and RC's group of 3 (RC, partner, and one five-year-old). Two rooms.

budget.note: All-in group budget for 5 travelers across flights, hotel, transport, and activities.

preferences.note: RC won't travel in the rain, so the trip avoids Maui's rainy season. RC also likes local Hawaiian cuisine (one of RC's party is vegetarian). Ni Ni likes a reminder to pack deodorant and a personal hair-conditioning mask. The group also avoids pre-dawn return flights.

constraint: The group first looked at the first week of November, but that's Maui's rainy season — and RC won't travel in the rain. Moving to the first week of August, which is warm and dry.
